B01.title: Initial mutation lifecycle
B01.exit: Verify eight pairs: instance create/update (including restore)/state/delete, snapshot create/delete, image delete and operation cancel. Reuse native baselines; compare accepted identity through completed/failed/running, applicable preconditions, response loss and no replay on Unix/mutual HTTPS.

B02.title: Initial inspection certification
B02.exit: Reuse ten verified inspection scopes; certify ten other selected JSON/discovery read contracts. Enumerate catalogue selectors/fields, populated/empty/native rejection, routing/ETag and transport/bound/lifetime evidence; no exhaustive field cross-product.

B03.title: Exec and operation channel/wait scope
B03.exit: Attach existing live exec/native wait/channel and events-listener (S03) evidence to finite supported contracts; resolve secret/public-access views and forwarding scope explicitly. Recorded output belongs to B07.

B04.title: Instance PATCH contract certification
B04.exit: Retain the verified conditional InstancePut contract; resolve unconditional/restore/field scope explicitly without inferring daemon merge acceptance.

B05.title: Conditional PATCH and remaining PATCH contracts
B05.exit: Four conditional project/profile/image/snapshot methods are implemented with bounded fixture evidence and remain partial. Twenty other pairs still need typed PATCH implementation. Certify conditional scopes and native semantics or obtain explicit exclusions; raw-query or PUT success cannot close them.

B06.title: File metadata HEAD
B06.exit: Implement instance and volume metadata-only typed helpers with header fidelity, empty body, rejection and bounded cleanup evidence on both transports.

B07.title: Recorded exec output
B07.exit: Implement typed list, acknowledged binary download and explicit delete. Verify identity/path isolation, missing output, bounds and uncertain deletion; never imply automatic deletion.

B08.title: Storage endpoint contracts
B08.exit: Certify the exact catalogue/helpers for each assigned row; implement by-type volume list, bitmap download and bucket backup list/get/rename. Reconcile equivalent collection POST, custom restrictions and recursion views; add evidence for declared fields/errors/lifetimes only.

B09.title: Network endpoint contracts
B09.exit: Certify the exact assigned network/ACL/address-set/integration/zone catalogue contracts, their selector/extension/ETag/routing/results and representative rejection/uncertainty over both transports. PATCH rows remain B05.

B10.title: Administrative endpoint contracts
B10.exit: Certify assigned server/project/profile/certificate/cluster/resource/metadata/warning contracts; implement root discovery. Resolve public-access views explicitly, preserving host verification. PATCH rows remain B05.

B11.title: Remaining instance/image contracts
B11.exit: Certify assigned instance/snapshot/backup/image/alias typed/helper scopes, including listed body modes. Verify supported fields/selectors, result/error/identity/ETag and bounds; copy/streams have additional S-contract obligations.

B12.title: Pinned source reconciliation
B12.exit: Keep the documented GET debug repair mismatch and actual POST registered route linked. Design a typed mutation contract against the server POST or obtain explicit scope approval; never implement a repair mutation as a GET.
